seen_animation: A black line-drawn broom stands left of center for the whole shot. Its double-line handle runs from the top-left of the frame down to a bristle head of splayed lines, and one long bristle curves out to the lower right. The bristles are cut off by the bottom edge in most frames. In frames 1-4 the broom holds its tilt (handle top to the upper left) with small side-to-side sway. In frames 5-7 the head shifts slightly left and the bristles spread wider. In frames 8-11 it returns to about the frame 1 position. In frames 12-13 the whole broom drops lower and moves slightly right, so the head sits near the bottom of the frame. In frames 14-16 it rises back to about the starting position. The tilt angle stays almost the same in every frame; the broom never stands upright. The grey scenery (two smaller upright grey brooms on the right and a few grey zigzag scraps) stays in place throughout, with small zigzag marks appearing near the broom head in frames 11-16.
seen_film: A real straw broom moves on its own in a dark room with debris on the floor and a white cloth hanging at the left. Frames 1-3: the main broom leans with its handle to the upper left and its head at lower center-left, while a second broom on the right swings toward it. Frames 4-5: the main broom slides down and left and the second broom swings over it from the upper right, crossing the frame. Frames 6-8: the main broom straightens to nearly upright, centered, and the second broom leaves at the top right. Frames 9-10: the main broom stands upright in the center with a narrow whisk broom standing upright to its right. Frames 11-13: the main broom tilts with its handle leaning toward the upper right and drops low in the frame; the whisk broom is hidden or behind it. Frames 14-16: the main broom stands upright again next to the upright whisk broom on its right, the two close together.
named_subject: A broom (straw broom with a long handle and splayed bristles).
evidence: The film's broom changes its lean: tilted to the upper left in frames 1-5, upright in frames 6-10, leaning the other way (handle to the upper right) in frames 11-13, upright in 14-16. The animation keeps the same upper-left tilt in all 16 frames (compare frame 1, frame 9 and frame 16: same angle). The film's second broom swings across the frame in frames 2-6 and the whisk broom stands beside the main broom in frames 9-10 and 14-16; in the animation the other brooms are static grey scenery on the far right in every frame and never approach the black broom. The animation does follow the film's drop in frames 12-13, where the black broom moves lower in the frame as the film's broom does. Frame-to-frame changes are small and no frame shows doubled lines, so the motion reads as continuous but too limited. Judged from still frames only, not playback.
primary_gap: The black broom never changes its lean: it should go from tilted upper-left to upright to tilted upper-right and back to upright as the film's broom does, but it holds one tilt throughout.
closes_when: The black broom's handle is near vertical and centered in frames 6-10 and 14-16, leans with its top to the upper right in frames 11-13, and keeps the upper-left lean only in frames 1-5.
protect: The doodle's construction: double-line handle with an open top, the bundle of separate splayed bristle strokes with the one long stroke curving out to the right, the plain unshaded black line. The continuity between frames with no doubling or redraw pops. The lowering of the broom in frames 12-13, which matches the film's timing.
identity_gap: The character is the c.png broom doodle rotated about 20 degrees, with the same double-line handle and splayed bristle strokes, so identity holds; the only difference is that it is never shown upright as the doodle is drawn.
